attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology

rules.accepted_credit_types: ASHA and ASHA-approved providers accepted automatically; other formal courses or presentations related to SLP practice need Board pre-approval (CEU Prior Approval form). 1 quarter hour of college coursework = 10 contact hours; 1 semester hour = 15 contact hours.
rules.audit_note: Copies of certificates of attendance, official college transcript or ASHA CEU transcript must be sent together with the renewal application; only CE from the current licensure period is accepted.
rules.notes: 1 unit = 10 credit hours, so 20 hours = 2.0 units. Licenses expire October 1 of the second year after issuance. The rule applies to all Board licensees, including speech-language pathology assistants (SLPA renewal fee $100). No mandatory topics. Audiologists are licensed by a different board (see the Audiologist rule).
rules.rule_quote: Per ARSD 20:79:02:05 all licensees are required to complete a minimum of 20 contact hours or 2.0 units of continuing education for each two-year renewal period.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities related to the practice of audiology that improve or maintain professional skills, or broaden or refresh knowledge of governing laws, rules or ethical standards
rules.new_licensee_rule: Does not apply to an audiologist renewing for the first time.
rules.audit_note: Evidence of completion is submitted with the annual renewal application due July 1; a waiver for illness or undue hardship must be requested by June 1.
rules.notes: Audiologists are licensed by the South Dakota Board of Hearing Aid Dispensers and Audiologists (https://doh.sd.gov/licensing-and-records/boards/audiology/), not the SLP board. Annual renewal by July 1. Rules amended effective October 7, 2025 (12 hours kept; first-renewal exemption added). No mandatory topics.
rules.rule_quote: To renew a license, an audiologist shall complete a minimum of twelve hours of continuing education on or before July first and submit evidence of completion with the application required by SDCL 36-24-28.1.
